notes: College of Arts and Humanities' Art History Four Year Academic Plan. The source PDF's term grid converts to garbled, column-interleaved text (Fall/Spring cells for four years run together), so exact per-slot Fall/Spring placement could not be reliably reconstructed; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. Term placement here follows the plan's legible signals: ARTH 2xx courses early (Years 1-2, before 3xx/4xx per the catalog's own sequencing note), ARTT100-or-110 in Year 2 (matches the plan's 'ARTT 100 or 110 (SP #1)' slot), ARTH488 last (Year 4 Spring, matching both the plan's late placement and the catalog's 75-credit enrollment gate), and the remaining 3xx/4xx and Supporting Area courses spread across Years 3-4 in the order the plan lists them. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.
ARTT100 or ARTT110 filled with ARTT100.
Select three ARTH 2xx courses filled with ARTH200, ARTH230, and ARTH255, all from the Academic Catalog list of real ARTH courses.
Select six additional ARTH 3xx/4xx courses filled with ARTH300, ARTH301, ARTH302, ARTH303, ARTH305, and ARTH313, all from the Academic Catalog list of real ARTH courses.

Supporting Area (3 courses, one non-ARTH department) filled with SOCY310, SOCY320, and SOCY335 -- real SOCY courses already used elsewhere in this codebase (socy-major-2026-27.ts, the amst-major plan, and sds-major-socy.json) -- chosen only to satisfy the single-department/level/credit shape.
